text: The person answering the phone was incredibly rude and spoke like a low-class, sarcastic, and disrespectful person. It was as if I was begging for service. Absolutely unacceptable. 31/12/68, 2:30 AM.
All the doctors are so lovely! They speak so well, give great advice to patients, and constantly chat with us to keep us from worrying. I really like them! I highly recommend Baan Fofun! ❤️😊 …
